name: RayNeo Control
author: YifePlayte
//flags: root is required: the glasses appear as a raw USB device (mode 0664 root:root), so a plugin running as the 'deck' user cannot libusb_open() them (LIBUSB_ERROR_ACCESS). Decky Loader honours flags:["root"] and starts the plugin as root, which removes the need for any udev rules. Verified against Decky Loader v3.2.10-pre1. | "debug" allows the plugin to be re-loaded while it is already running: loader.py refuses a second load unless the flag is set ("has requested to not be re-loaded"). It exists for reloading after a zip install without restarting Decky. It is not read anywhere else in the loader -- it does not enable any extra logging.

publish.description: Control a connected RayNeo (FFalcon) XR display: brightness, 2D/3D, screen size, scene mode, HDR, colour enhance, volume, audio mode, audio tube.
